description: This file defines the NatsAdapter class, which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for integrating NATS streaming into Orleans. It provides methods to create receivers and enqueue message batches with serialization support.

classes.name: NatsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter implementing IQueueAdapter for NATS streaming, enabling message reception and batch message queuing within Orleans.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NatsQueueAdapterReceiver for a specified queue.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously serializes and enqueues a batch of messages to NATS.
